title: TensorFold cluster
description: Nodes, how the leader reaches them for the launch step, their MCDMA links, and per model the nodes, parallel layout and budgets. The data plane is MCDMA direct memory access only.

transport.description: Direct memory access over MCDMA links; there is no TCP transport.

ssh.description: Key-only access for the launch step.

key.description: Private key file; password logins are never used.

links.description: The data plane's MCDMA links, each declared once for both ends, so both read the same name, kind and path MTU. A model's nodes on real hosts need one link between every pair of them.

address.description: Host or IP for the launch step, never the data plane.

via.description: A node this one is reached through (its jump host); one hop only.

gpu_limit_gb.description: What the GPU may hold; inventory fills it in.

library.description: libmcdma-fabric on this node, an absolute path; MCDMA's library is loaded from no other place.

bin.description: This node's tensorfold, an absolute path, for the launch over ssh (whose non-interactive PATH has only the system directories). Absent: tensorfold from that PATH.

name.description: The link name both ends give MCDMA.

kind.description: The kind both ends must report: tb5 (Thunderbolt, Mac to Mac) or cx5 (ConnectX, RoCE v2). Absent: whichever connects.

mtu.description: The RC path MTU, at most each port's active MTU.

device.description: The RDMA device (rdma_mcrdma0 on a Mac's ConnectX, the ibv_devices name on Linux); Thunderbolt members may be joined with +.

via.description: The meeting interface, a slash, then the other end's address on the same segment, e.g. en7/192.0.2.10.

port.description: This end's exchange port; the other end connects to it.

gid.description: The GID index; required for cx5: 0 on a Mac (the MCDMA kext has index 0 only), the RoCE v2 index on Linux. Absent on Thunderbolt: 1, or -1 for a bond of more than two devices.

mode.description: converged: lane rounds span every node, prompt and decode rows together; disaggregated: prefill nodes hand KV caches to decode nodes.

context.description: Tokens each stream may hold; admission sizes caches for streams x context.

streams.description: Concurrent streams the caches are sized for.

rows.description: Decode rows one round may carry.

chunk.description: Prompt rows a round takes while streams decode; 0: admission sizes it.

mla.description: MLA attention split by heads (latent cache on every rank) or by streams (caches split, weights replicated).
